title: Protecting Families of Fallen Servicemembers Act
official_summary:
Protecting Families of Fallen Servicemembers Act

This bill revises the conditions allowing a service member to terminate a commercial mobile, telephone exchange, internet access, or multichannel video programming service contract at any time after the date the service member receives military orders to relocate for at least 90 days to a location that does not support such contract. It treats as individuals covered, and therefore allowed to terminate such a contract (1) a spouse or dependent of a service member who dies while in military service or a member of the reserve components performing full-time or active reserve duty or inactive-duty training; (2) a spouse or dependent of a service member who incurs a catastrophic injury or illness, if the member incurs the injury or illness while in military service or performing such duty; and (3) a member of the reserve components performing such duty.

summary.headline: This 2021 law lets certain military families end phone, internet, and TV contracts early when service-related situations make the service unusable or unnecessary.
summary.what_it_does: The law changes when a service member can cancel a phone, internet, or TV contract early. A service member may cancel at any time after receiving orders to move at least 90 days to a place where the service is not available. The law also gives the same right to certain spouses and dependents, and to some reserve members, in cases involving a death or a catastrophic injury or illness connected to military service.

who_it_affects.how: They may end a covered phone, internet, or TV contract early after getting orders to relocate for at least 90 days to a place that does not support the service.

who_it_affects.group: Spouses and dependents of service members who die while in military service
who_it_affects.how: They can end a covered contract early under the law's rules.

who_it_affects.group: Spouses and dependents of service members who suffer a catastrophic injury or illness during military service
who_it_affects.how: They can end a covered contract early when the injury or illness happened while the member was serving.

who_it_affects.group: Reserve component members performing full-time, active reserve, or inactive-duty training duty
who_it_affects.how: They are treated as covered individuals who may end a covered contract early.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: Enacted January 5, 2021. The official summary does not describe a separate effective date.
